speaker: Doctor
text:
That is strange; the initial labs were normal, so let's look deeper into your exposure. Have you been in an area with standing water or recently eaten shellfish, and did you notice any specific skin lesions or joint swelling?

speaker: Doctor
text:
The repeated normal results for liver function, ammonia, and urinalysis make acute viral hepatitis or severe rhabdomyolysis unlikely. Have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the eyes/skin), abdominal swelling, or easy bruising/bleeding?
